name: daintree.gitlab
description: First-party GitLab forge provider — issues, merge requests, CI status, and releases for gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab instances.
tagline: Merge requests, issues, and pipelines for GitLab repositories

settings.label: GitLab instance URL
settings.description: Base URL of the GitLab instance Daintree authenticates against. Change for self-hosted GitLab.

credentialFields.label: Personal access token
credentialFields.helpText: Create under GitLab → User settings → Access tokens with the api scope (read_api works for read-only use).
